title: Siruthai
desc: Rocket Raja, a small-time thief, comes across a young girl who calls him father. However, when Raja finds the truth about the girl's past, he turns into a vigilante.

title: Devil
desc: Set in pre-independence India, a covert intelligence operative gets tangled in love, deception and betrayal, while investigating the mysterious murder of a zamindar's daughter.

title: Odela 2
desc: When a rapist is improperly buried, his ghost begins haunting his village and attacking innocent women. As chaos arises, the villagers look for an answer.

title: Maari 2
desc: Maariyappan, a gangster, is confronted by Gangadhar Beeja, a rival. While he strives to defeat him, he attempts to cope with his son's questionable behaviour.

title: Saamy
desc: Aarusaamy, a police officer, accepts bribes from Perumal, a gangster, in order to maintain peace in his district. However, circumstances force him to go against Perumal.
